_about: Machine constants of the Dex planner's cost model (dex/planner/models.py) and the scheduler's link model (dex/scheduler/fwd.py, bwd.py), for the evaluation cluster (4 nodes x 4 RTX A5000, PCIe without NVLink, one 200 Gb/s InfiniBand NIC per node). They are the article's three kinds of constant: compute rate (t_tile_s with a_comp, the backward coef with k_comp, the InfLLM entry times), link bandwidth (b_*, bw_*, kappa, c_arr_s, lat_*) and fixed tail (gamma, c_end_s, c0_s, gamma_local). Each kind has one entry per compute routine, pass or link the implementation uses; the file is measured once per cluster and the same values serve every workload and both passes. The constants only rank candidate plans; they are not meant to reproduce measured latencies. On another cluster, measure per-tile, per-task / per-item and per-entry times with single-GPU runs of each routine, bandwidths and latencies with point-to-point transfers, and the dimensionless factors and fixed costs from a few plan executions there. Units are in each key's suffix: _s seconds, _gib_s GiB/s (2^30 bytes per second), _b_s bytes per second, no suffix = dimensionless.

forward._about: Forward model: per GPU score = max(a_comp * compute, arrival + gamma * a_comp * compute that waits for inter-node inputs) + c_end; node arrival from NIC bytes (kappa = share of the opposite direction's bytes on the same NIC) + c_arr. t_tile_s: per-tile time of a single-GPU dense pass; a_comp: its scale to the per-tile time inside a distributed plan. gamma_local: tail weight of intra-node bytes in the GPU-level KV re-split's local view.

backward._about: Backward model: compute = item time x items + task time x tasks; per GPU score = max(k_comp * compute, copy-engine bytes / b_eng, NIC time) + c0. task_s / item_s are single-GPU times of 63 tasks / 63 items of the backward routine for each (query heads, KV heads) shape; the model divides by 63. The MHA shapes 8x8 and 4x4 use the 16x16 times: on equal query and KV heads the routine's time scales with the head count, which the model already applies (items x 4 query heads, tasks x 2 KV heads).

infllm._about: InfLLM-v2 planner: seconds per entry (one token x one selected 64-key block, 16 query heads) of the official forward row routine / backward column routine on one GPU, measured on selections at 32K / 64K / 128K tokens.

links._about: Scheduler link model: per-message transfer time = latency + bytes / bandwidth on its link.
links._bwd_item_s: backward scheduler's work estimate: single-GPU time of 63 items (the scheduler divides by backward.profile_count)
